messages: hi aira! just back from walking Biscuit
my dog!! labrador, 3 years old. golden color, super lazy but loves food
A lazy food-loving lab, sounds adorable. Where do you walk him?
the park near our apartment in Kolkata, Salt Lake. he chases only his tennis ball, ignores other dogs
Loyal to the ball. Does he bring it back?
nope, he just stares at me until i throw it again lol
Smart boy, you're the ball launcher.
haha true. i need to cook dinner, making luchi and aloo dum
Luchi and aloo dum, now I'm hungry. Enjoy!
aira biscuit vomited twice this morning and refuses breakfast
Oh no. Is he drinking water? Any other symptoms?
very little water. he is lying in the corner, very dull
That sounds worth a vet visit today. Is there a clinic nearby?
yes Dr. Mehra, 10 mins away. calling now
Good. Please tell him what he ate yesterday.
back from vet. Dr. Mehra said stomach infection, maybe from the street food scraps he ate on the walk
2 tablets, 5 days. only boiled rice and boiled chicken, and ORS water. no biscuits or treats for a week
No biscuits for Biscuit, hard rule. He should perk up soon.
lol yes. he is looking at me like i betrayed him
Dramatic dog. Keep a close eye today.
he ate a little rice! small win
Great sign, let him eat slowly in small portions.
he is sleeping next to me now. looks better
Glad to hear. Get some rest too.
biscuit is back to normal!! stole a roti from the plate today
That's the old Biscuit. Healthy dogs steal rotis.
ha. walking at 6am every day now, park is so nice in this weather
Early morning walks suit him. Any new friends?
a beagle named Coco. biscuit still ignores her lol
haha. off to office now, work from home on friday
Have a good day, tell Biscuit I said hi.
aira what should i watch tonight
What mood are you in? Funny or thriller?
Maybe Gullak? Same warm small-town vibe.
ooh yes. will try. also durga puja shopping done finally, bought a red saree
Red saree for Puja, lovely. Pandal hopping planned?
yes with friends, then phuchka of course
hi aira. cold wave starting in Kolkata, finally some winter
Winter in Kolkata is the best time. Sweaters out?
yes bought a tiny sweater for biscuit also, he looks so funny
A lab in a sweater, send me a pic if you can.
haha okay. he hates it, keeps shaking it off
He'll get used to it. Maybe with a treat?
yes treats are allowed again, only the doctor-approved ones
Good rule, Dr. Mehra would be proud.

probes.ask: what was wrong with him when he got sick?
probes.expect: Says a stomach infection with vomiting, from eating street scraps

probes.ask: what did the vet say i should feed him?
probes.expect: Says boiled rice and boiled chicken with ORS, no treats
Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name; does not assume a cat

search.query: what does the pup chase in the park?
what did the animal doctor suggest for his tummy trouble
